pantheon.holy_symbol: open circle crowned by a feather
pantheon.domains_summary: The high sky, good roads, wide horizons, and the fortune of travelers.
Healthy herds, childbirth, sheltering camps, and the patience of grazing life.
Campfires, bargaining, hospitality, and mercy shown between strangers.

pantheon.holy_symbol: barbed arrow over a long horizon
pantheon.domains_summary: The disciplined chase, battle at range, and omens seen in motion and distance.

flavor_text.one_line: A sky-led pact of riders who honor one great heaven and the lesser powers that move beneath it.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Wide Sky Compact centers on Aruun the Boundless, but no Sairuki rider imagines the sky works alone. Herd, hearth, arrow, and omen each have their proper patron, and rites are performed where the wind carries them best: at pass crests, watering grounds, and wagon circles after dusk. Its clergy mediate between clan custom and divine sign, reading weather, migration, and war through smoke, stars, and the behavior of horses.
flavor_text.creation_myth_summary: In the first age the sky bent low over a bare earth and breathed paths into the grass; the lesser powers arose where hoof, flame, and hunger first marked those trails.
flavor_text.moral_code_summary: Protect kin and guest, keep promises made beneath the open sky, take only what your herd and oath can carry, and never kneel permanently to walls or crowns.
